films.title: Edipo re
films.description: Pasolini's Oedipus still rests on Corinthian fosterage — Polybus and Merope as the gentle parents the hero flees, believing them the parents of the oracle's doom.

films.title: Oedipus the King
films.description: Saville's Sophocles adaptation keeps the Corinthian lie at the tragedy's core: Polybus' death-news is the false comfort that drives Oedipus toward recognition.

music.title: Oedipus Rex
music.description: Stravinsky's Latin opera-oratorio still needs Corinth: the messenger from Polybus' house who thinks he brings mercy and instead opens the wound of birth.

popCulture.title: Oedipus Rex
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' tragedy makes Polybus of Corinth the foster-father whose supposed death frees Oedipus from fear — until the Corinthian messenger reveals the adoption that unravels Thebes.

popCulture.title: Polybus of Corinth
popCulture.description: Childless king who raised the exposed infant as his own — the gentle Corinthian father Oedipus flees so as not to kill, and whose name still marks the foster half of the Theban plot.
